producedBy: Local P.Book Python runtime (training/server.py POST /api/run and POST /api/strategy/step).
disclosure: Simulated execution against saved price tapes. No broker, no live orders, no real money.

policy.timing: Decide after a completed bar; execute at the next available bar open.
policy.execution: All-or-nothing target rebalance, adverse slippage and fees; no actual order book or liquidity inference.
policy.rounding: Execution price, fees and account money use Decimal, cents, ROUND_HALF_UP.
policy.funding: Long-only integer units, full cash funding, no leverage or shorting.
policy.terminal: Final-bar pending intents expire; open positions are marked, not liquidated.
policy.benchmarkDescription: 1 index simulation unit held from the first open; remaining initial cash stays in cash. No benchmark fees or slippage. This is not a fully invested buy-and-hold return.

provenance.symbolSelection: POST /api/run accepts an optional symbol validated against this market's catalog. The three on_bar starters were run once per instrument (^GSPC, AAPL, MSFT, NVDA); each run carries its own symbol, datasetId and datasetChecksum, and the ^GSPC runs were requested without a symbol, on the market default tape.
provenance.determinism: Bars come from the retained verified source tape; run ids are content hashes of engine version, tape, code and config.
